newsitem.title: USA: Lehman to buy $1.23 billion of loans from NCB.
newsitem.headline: Lehman to buy $1.23 billion of loans from NCB.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. said Thursday it has agreed to buy $1.23 billion of commercial loans from Nippon Credit Bank Ltd. in the largest secondary transaction in the history of syndicated lending.
The portfolio is made up of project finance and corporate loans made by Nippon Credit's New York office.
The Wall Street firm said it will sell some of the loans and repackage some into securities.
Lehman started loan syndication and trading activities in 1992. The company said it has acted as agent or participated in more than $28 billion in loans in the past 12 months.
Lehman's stock was unchanged at $37.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
